title: Twin phone dashboard build-up
summary: Two bezel-less phone screens fade up on a light stage, then a finance dashboard assembles itself: tinted metric cards with rolling numbers and rings, rising bars, a 2x2 stat grid. Holds on a slow push, fades out to an empty loop.
use_when: Showing a finance, sales or analytics mobile app in one short loop
A silent autoplay shot for a landing page hero or a social card
Proving the product tracks numbers: metrics, progress and a chart on one screen
Opening a longer film with a calm, light product reveal

look.type_style: geometric sans, semibold headings and figures, sentence case, normal tracking; greeting ~3 % H, card figures ~3 % H, captions ~1.3 % H in light grey

sfx.event: metric card or stat tile appears

structure.shot: empty light stage: large grey disc and three small coloured dots; left phone screen fades up with header and greeting
structure.camera: push-in starts, scale creep decelerating (zoom 9.3 %/s in the first second, motion.json)
structure.motion: stage alone f0-f6; left screen opacity 0 -> 1 with a small rise, easings.outQuint 6 fr (f6-f12, 30 fps strip); header row and greeting with the screen

structure.shot: right screen fades up offset lower; left screen fills with three tinted metric cards, right screen with a five-bar chart
structure.motion: right screen fade-up easings.outQuint 5 fr, 6 fr after the left; cards cascade, stagger ~4 fr, fade + rise easings.outExpo 8 fr; figures roll up in a clip mask (counter, rolling) ~10 fr; bars rise left to right on springs.chartBar, stagger 2 fr, value labels fade in after each bar

structure.shot: chart title appears, then a 2x2 grid of stat tiles under it; rings on the metric cards finish drawing; bottom nav icons appear
structure.motion: tiles fade + rise row by row, stagger ~4 fr, easings.outExpo 8 fr (overshoot not measurable); progress arcs draw clockwise easings.outQuint ~12 fr; all settled by f38 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: complete dashboard on both screens, held; no element changes
structure.camera: push-in about 1.00 -> 1.05 over 97 fr, decelerating (2.4 -> 0.35 %/s, motion.json), easings.outQuint
structure.motion: none; only the camera creep and a slight upward drift of both screens (~2 % H)

structure.shot: screens fade out left first, then right, back to the empty stage that opened the film
structure.motion: left screen opacity 1 -> 0 easings.inExpo 5 fr from f135; right screen same 4 fr, starts 2 fr later; empty from f141 to f150 so the loop seam is invisible

params.brand: any brand.json: bg, fg, muted, accent and two extra tints for the metric cards
params.content.greeting: short header line on the left screen, 2 words, plus a muted sub-line of 2 words
params.content.metrics: 3 metric cards: label, muted sub-label, value, ring percentage
params.loop: end on the empty stage so the clip loops (default true)

notes: Single continuous shot, no cuts, silent. Build lasts 0.20-1.27 s (f6-f38), hold 1.27-4.50, staggered fade-out 4.50-4.70, then 9 empty frames = first frame, so it loops. Screens are white rounded cards with soft shadows and no bezel or notch. Proposed term: fade-up-loop (empty stage at both ends). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Family chosen mobile-app over the catalogue hint product-ui because both screens are phones.
